name: znetwork_dplay_open_selected_session_and_read_status_fields
description: zNetworkDPlay::OpenSelectedSessionAndReadStatusFields opens the selected enumerated DirectPlay session and copies status fields back to the caller.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.

Binary Ninja reconstruction remains limited around the DirectPlay Open failure switch and string-copy loop; assembly validates the selected-cache, Open, caps-query, close-on-caps-failure, and status-field copy behavior.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/HLIL for 0x48a520 validates fetching g_zNetwork_EnumeratedSessionList at statusFields->selectedSessionIndex, assigning g_zNetwork_CurrentSessionDescCache, setting openMode to 1 and desc.size to 0x50, calling IDirectPlay4::Open with flags 1, querying caps on successful Open, closing DirectPlay on caps-query failure, and copying custom status fields/maxPlayers/sessionName into the caller structure.

Native smoke znetwork_dplay_open_selected_session_and_read_status_fields_smoke verifies success field propagation, DirectPlay Open arguments, missing selected-session behavior, and Close on caps-query failure.
